description: Create the Workflow Automation module with seed data, storage layer, AppContext integration, routing, sidebar nav, and the main page with four tabs: Rule Builder, Automation Templates, Execution Log, and Scheduled Actions.
steps: Create src/data/seedAutomations.js with deterministic seed data including: (a) automationRules - array of 6-8 rules with fields: id, name, description, enabled, priority, conditions (array of condition groups with AND/OR logic, each condition having field/operator/value), actions (array with type like send_email/update_status/create_task/add_to_cohort/trigger_alert and params), createdAt, updatedAt, triggerCount, successCount, failureCount; (b) automationTemplates - array of 5-6 pre-built templates with id, name, description, category, conditions, actions, isActive, parameters (customizable fields); (c) executionLog - array of 15-20 log entries with id, ruleId, ruleName, triggeredAt, completedAt, status (success/failure/skipped), triggerEvent, actionsExecuted, errorDetails (for failures), canRetry; (d) scheduledActions - array of 6-8 scheduled items with id, ruleId, ruleName, cronExpression, nextRunAt, lastRunAt, timezone, enabled, batchSize, description

Add storage functions in src/lib/storage.js: getAutomationRules/saveAutomationRules, getAutomationTemplates/saveAutomationTemplates, getExecutionLog/saveExecutionLog, getScheduledActions/saveScheduledActions. Add seedAutomations import and initialization block in initializeData()

Add state and update functions to src/context/AppContext.jsx for automationRules, automationTemplates, executionLog, scheduledActions following the existing pattern (useState with getter, useCallback updater that calls save, expose both in value)

Create src/pages/Automations.jsx with four tabs: Rule Builder (Zap icon), Automation Templates (BookTemplate icon), Execution Log (ScrollText icon), Scheduled Actions (CalendarClock icon). Follow the exact tabbed UI pattern from src/pages/Integrations.jsx or src/pages/AuditTrail.jsx
Add route in src/App.jsx: import Automations page and add <Route path='/automations' element={<Automations />} /> after the /settings route
Add nav item in src/components/layout/Sidebar.jsx: import Zap from lucide-react, add { path: '/automations', label: 'Automations', icon: Zap } to NAV_ITEMS array (before Settings)
acceptance_criteria: npm run build succeeds with no errors
The /automations route renders a page with four tabs
Sidebar shows Automations link with Zap icon between Audit Trail and Settings
Seed data is generated and stored in localStorage on first load
AppContext exposes automationRules, automationTemplates, executionLog, scheduledActions and their update functions
verification: Run npm run build and confirm exit code 0 with no errors
findings: Build succeeds. BookTemplate icon is available in lucide-react. All four tabs render correctly with seed data. No test framework to run unit tests - verified via npm run build.
